items.title: These Boeing Directors Just Bought Shares. Here’s What Wall Street Thinks.
items.summary: Two Boeing board members opened their wallets while the stock slid well below its highs, and analysts are lining up behind them. A stubborn production problem could still decide whether the bullish bet pays off.

items.title: Joby Gains 4% on Revenue Beat and Raised Outlook; Archer Aviation Falls 5%, EHang Sinks 7%
items.summary: While rivals Archer and EHang slide, Joby is climbing on the strength of an unlikely engine: a ride-booking business it bought. But a pile of debt, big losses, and a certification clock that keeps ticking could still ground the rally.

items.title: Boeing, ServiceNow and Nebius Keep Their Stock Off ICE-OKX Token Venue, Lifting Objectors to 62
items.summary: The venue’s Nov. 4 notice adds Boeing, ServiceNow and Nebius Group to a list that already named Apple, Home Depot and GE Vernova, and the venture has yet to say when trading will start.

items.title: Caught Out By Boeing's Slide? Here's What The Bears Saw
items.summary: If you backed Boeing for its record backlog, rising deliveries and heavyweight defense contracts, the recent update would have stung. Holding Boeing from the start of the year would have meant a 22.3% loss, including dividends. If that result sits uncomfortably, the real question is sharper than “what went wrong?” Which parts of the original growth, margin and P/E assumptions for 2028 failed to account for what actually unfolded inside the business?
